headline: MiniMax H3 Image ported to Apple Metal without PyTorch
lede: Mac users can run MiniMax H3 Image on Metal alone, with a cold 2048x2048 image falling from 229 to 61 seconds on an M5 Ultra and byte-identical pixels.

with.title: Meta's DINOv3 ViT-L image features trend on Hugging Face

possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-11 Magpie suggested agencies self-host image generation with a cheap vision model as a quality gate; today the Metal port cuts a cold 2048x2048 image from 229 to 61 seconds on an M5 Ultra with byte-identical pixels, and DINOv3 features let the gate compare outputs to approved brand references instead of trusting captions.
